name: suguru
description: 数方 Suguru — 零猜测区域推理. 出题时由铅笔求解器实测：每一局都唯一可解、且只用「区域装 1..k」+「相邻（含对角）不同数」两条规则就能把整盘推到底, 难度分与档位区间都是量出来的.

scripts.check: for f in js/*.js js/*/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && node --check server.cjs && node --check electron/main.cjs && node --check electron/preload.cjs && node --check tools/playtest.cjs && bash -n tools/verify.sh && for f in tools/*.mjs tools/scenarios.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && echo OK
